description: This file contains implementation of property access functions (`SlapScoStdGetProperty` and `SlapScoStdSetProperty`) for the Slap Sco Standard Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It handles retrieving and configuring object properties via an external interface, involving parameter list processing, object property retrieval, and method invocation.

methods.name: SLAP_VARIABLE * SlapScoStdGetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Retrieves a pre-registered object property value by property name, invokes the associated method, and returns the result.

methods.name: SLAP_VARIABLE * SlapScoStdSetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Configures a pre-registered object property value by property name, invoking the corresponding method.
